about: Every oracle (OR-) and LIC-1 case of docs/semantics/conformance.md is accounted for: cited by a test or a data case of internal/oracle, internal/conformance or conformance/flows; or checked live by every oracle session in CI (live); or deferred to the milestone that records or implements it (deferred). TestCatalogueCoverage enforces it.

live.by: every session: WaitReady requires /api/version to be exactly CE v1.767.0, and Pinned.CheckIdentity requires the pinned digest in RepoDigests
every session: WaitReady waits at most 180 s for a healthy status; the session report records boot times, image sizes and memory peaks
every session: Bootstrap logs in with the seeded superadmin, NewWorkspace creates the run's workspace and requires an empty queue
the oracle workflow: wltest record --regenerate-metadata, then git status on conformance/ (the metadata drift gate)
every session: teardown runs compose down -v and requires no container, volume or network with the project label
the oracle workflow itself: record --check on a clean checkout, failing on a changed observation and never on provenance

the oracle workflow's second session: wltest record --check with --listen-interval 10 and two workers records the smoke fixture, whose committed recordings were made at 1 s with one worker, and fails unless every observation is unchanged

every session: CheckSetup reads each setup.yaml variable back after the push, requiring 404 for a fixture with oracle.setup before_push, whose push removed it (oracle/seeded), and 200 once setup.yaml was applied after the push

deferred.reason: a provenance check of windmill-lite's own Bun harness, which wltest check owns
optional (Q-OR-14): the knob MAX_RESULT_SIZE_MB would change every observation of the session it is set for, and no milestone of ADR 0012 implements the result-size limit's error
